title: Length-4 permutation-pattern avoidance counts n<=7
rootQuestion: Validate length-4 permutation-pattern avoidance counts for n <= 7, using co-math to track computation artifacts, finite claims, warnings, review, and paper export. Record whether computation provenance is now cumbersome enough to justify /comath computation

approvedGoals.summary: Exhaustively validate single length-4 permutation-pattern avoidance counts for n <= 7.
Record computation artifacts, finite claims, warnings, review status, and export a short paper report.
Assess whether the manual provenance burden justifies a /comath computation workflow.

workstreams.title: Finite exhaustive computation
workstreams.summary: Two brute-force enumerators agreed for all 24 patterns and n=0..7.

workstreams.title: Provenance and paper export
workstreams.summary: Stored script, JSON output, and Markdown report under .pi/co-math/artifacts.

claims.statement: For each of the 24 length-4 patterns, the exact number of avoiding permutations for n=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 is the value listed in artifact-2.

Through n=7 the 24 patterns fall into three observed count classes: counts [1,1,2,6,23,103,512,2740] for 10 patterns; [1,1,2,6,23,103,513,2761] for 12 patterns; and [1,1,2,6,23,103,513,2762] for patterns 1324 and 4231.
For this small exhaustive computation, manual co-math provenance bookkeeping was cumbersome enough to justify a dedicated /comath computation workflow.

evidence.summary: Script enumerated all permutations and checked pattern containment by combinations plus standardization.
Independent nested-loop/direct-ranking checker agreed for all 192 pattern/length pairs.
Report records that provenance bookkeeping dominated the small finite computation.

warnings.summary: The two computational methods share exhaustive permutation enumeration and are not fully independent.
Claims are finite for n <= 7 only; no all-n Wilf-equivalence or asymptotic claim is made.
Counts include n=0 as one empty permutation.

artifacts.title: Validated length-4 avoidance counts for n <= 7

reviewRounds.summary: Checked that both methods agree for 192 pattern/length pairs, artifact hashes were recorded, and warnings limit the claims to finite n <= 7.

marginNotes.summary: Manual provenance for tiny computations is high-overhead; recommend /comath computation support.
